unrelated to the always-visible-agent-header work being verified (full-run
report `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/1a60d5890dc0472a8937a41669447a75/report/summary.md`,
targeted `--check` report
`.pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/b3c6d8e00a44426f91d51b1f69bb74f3/report/summary.md`):

  `axe_lumberjack_description_120x40.png`,
  `axe_lumberjack_error_120x40.png`, `axe_lumberjack_tree_120x40.png`,
  `axe_selected_row_120x40.png`
- `help_guide_axe_120x40.png`
- `launch_context_bar_full_density_160x40.png`,
  `launch_context_bar_services_120x40.png`
- `link_rail_axe_twelve_links_120x40.png`,
  `link_rail_axe_twelve_links_60x30.png`

(`help_guide_agents_120x40.png` also drifted but is already owned by
bead sase-16a; it is excluded here. The 27th update,
`agents_file_only_layout_120x40.png`, is the intended header-change
golden and stays.)

Why not a flake and not caused by the header work: the same mismatches
reproduce in `--check` mode and on a fully stashed clean tree (sampled
`test_axe_selected_row_png_snapshot` plus both family-gate snapshots
fail identically with HEAD goldens and pristine src). Inspected
family-gate old-vs-new frames differ in Agents-tab footer Enter labels
(`go to PR` vs `choose action`) and shell-list scrollbar offsets while
the test never leaves the default metadata-only layout, so neither the
header-visibility rule nor the `.expanded` CSS (which only applies in
`SECONDARY_ONLY`) can reach these scenes. All 26 regenerated goldens
were reverted to keep the header diff clean; only
`agents_file_only_layout_120x40.png` remains modified.

Remedy: regenerate these 26 goldens deliberately per scene group and
inspect each diff against the source drift (footer Enter-label
resolution, scroll offsets, axe/help/launch copy) before accepting.
